next.reason: 1985: "MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement."; 2023: "`MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1` or `MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1`". The MOVE-then-WRITE equivalence for FROM identifier-1 is kept. 2023 adds a case the 1985 rule lacks: FROM literal-1, defined as MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1.
